experiment: Voxel session I (combined paper W2): scale study. W2b: Voxel's rediscretised multigrid with three FP64 finest kernels on upsampled optimized cantilevers up to tens of millions of DOFs on RTX 4090, A100 80 GB and H100. W2a: Yang et al.'s Galerkin GMG at 1 M and 2 M elements with four FP64 arms on the 80 GB cards.
status_at_declaration: Declared before any session I rental. One byte-identical package runs on each GPU type (one rental each).
questions: H13: on the A100 and H100 (FP64:FP32 = 1:2), is modal8_muladd within 1.05x of node_fp64 in all-FP64 multigrid (fixed work), i.e. no consumer-GPU-style gain?
H14: on the RTX 4090, does the all-FP64 multigrid gain of modal8_muladd over fused_ai_fp64 stay >= 1.18x at the largest size that fits (fixed work)?
Scale: which sizes (4.2 M to 47.8 M elements, 12.8 M to 143 M DOFs) fit each card with each multigrid, and at what time to 1e-8?
W2a: inside Yang et al.'s GMG at 1 M and 2 M elements on 80 GB cards, what are the fixed-work ratios among the four FP64 arms?

inputs.generator: make_inputs.py (nearest-neighbour upsampling of session E's optimized q64/q96 cantilevers; clamp and consistent line load regenerated by the same rule, exact at factor 1)

cases.note: session E's q96 design (1.77 M elements), continuity

ladder_rule: cases run in the order above; the first out-of-memory case ends the ladder on that card (recorded)

products.vector: seeded standard normal (order_seed + q), constrained DOFs zeroed; raw operator product timed

solver.outer: flexible CG (Polak-Ribiere), FP64, true-residual test every iteration with residual replacement

multigrid.omega: 4/(3 lambda_l), lambda_l by 30 seeded power iterations on the FP64 hierarchy with node_fp64 finest; shared by all arms
multigrid.coarse_levels_kernel: node_fp64 (FP64 arms) / node_fp32 (FP32 V-cycle arms), identical for all arms
multigrid.coarsest_solve: dense Cholesky of the constrained operator assembled on the host, shared by all arms

fixed_work.rule: K = max converged outer iterations of mg64-fused_ai over its to-tolerance repetitions; every arm runs exactly K outer iterations

decision.physical: every to-tolerance solve must pass session E's independent C-reference physical check (true residual <= 1e-7, energy/force <= 1e-6, exact zero constrained DOFs)
decision.H13: on each 80 GB card, for every primary case that fits: median over fixed-work rounds of time(mg64-modal8_muladd)/time(mg64-node) >= 1/1.05, i.e. node_fp64 is not beaten by more than 5 %; reported with the fused_ai ratio
decision.H14: on the RTX 4090, at the largest primary case that fits: median fixed-work time(mg64-fused_ai)/time(mg64-modal8_muladd) >= 1.18
decision.w2a: descriptive: fixed-work ratios among the four arms per size and schedule; setup time and memory
decision.stop: no threshold changes after results; out-of-memory cases are results

not_claimed: Fixed-work ratios are kernel/solver effects, not complete-optimization speedups.
Upsampled designs are geometrically the same optimized cantilever at higher resolution, not new optimizations.
